web.stack_hint: HAProxy routes ports 80/443 (IPv4 + IPv6) by SNI; Nginx and each PHP-FPM version run as Docker containers. Configs are generated from the database.
web.no_docker: Docker is not available. Re-run the install command (it installs Docker).
web.not_installed: The web stack is not installed yet; it is installed with your first site (uses ports 80 / 443).
web.cf_token_hint: Permissions: Zone → DNS → Edit and Zone → Zone → Read. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
web.acme_directory_hint: From your LiteSSL / CA dashboard, together with the EAB key ID and HMAC key.
web.tos: Requesting a certificate accepts the selected CA's terms of service.

site.php_switch_hint: Takes effect immediately; a version used for the first time takes a few minutes to build.
site.dns_hint: Creates A (IPv4) and AAAA (IPv6) records pointing to this server
site.need_cf: Set a Cloudflare API token under Web stack first
site.ssl_http_hint: The domain must already point to this server (port 80 reachable)
site.ssl_dns_hint: Validated via Cloudflare TXT records; supports wildcards
site.ssl_disable_confirm: Remove this site's certificate and turn off Force HTTPS?
site.cf_hint_title: The domain is proxied by Cloudflare (orange cloud)
site.cf_hint_dns: Use DNS-01 (Cloudflare) instead, which is not affected by the proxy; or temporarily set Cloudflare SSL/TLS mode to Full (not strict) and switch back to Full (strict) once issued.
site.cf_hint_token: Cloudflare rejects the origin until it has a valid certificate (526 in Full (strict) mode). Easiest: add a Cloudflare API token under Web stack and request with DNS-01; or temporarily set SSL/TLS mode to Full (not strict).
site.need_runtime: Install this runtime from the App Store first.
site.app_port_hint: The app listens on 127.0.0.1:PORT (env PORT / HOST)
site.command_hint: Runs in the project directory with sh -c; empty = default for the runtime
site.proxy_target_hint: http(s)://host:port, e.g. a Docker container on 127.0.0.1
site.passthrough: TLS passthrough (the backend holds the certificate)
site.passthrough_hint: host:port of a TLS backend; HTTP redirects to HTTPS

app.remove_data: Also delete its data and image
app.name: App
app.config_hint: Saving restarts the service; if it does not come back, the previous file is restored.
app.loopback_hint: Listens on loopback only. Websites and projects on this server connect to this address.
